product_info.name: Wells Fargo Active Cash Credit Card

terms_analysis.key_information:
**Key Points:**
- **Standard variable APR of 19.24-29.24%** for purchases (typical for mainstream cards), with **no annual fee** - a positive feature for everyday spending cards
- **2% cash back on all purchases** with no rotating categories to track - simple and competitive for a no-fee card
- **Pro:** No annual fee combined with 2% flat-rate rewards is excellent value - most 2% cards charge fees or require banking relationships
- **Con:** High cash advance APR at 29.99% and 5% fee make this expensive for getting cash (though standard for the industry)
terms_analysis.risks:
**Potential Risks:**
- **[MEDIUM]** Late payment fees up to $40 can add up quickly if you miss payments - very common across all credit cards.
  **Impact:** Missing one payment costs $40 plus potential APR increases on your entire balance
terms_analysis.consumer_score:
**Credit Card Consumer Score:** 62/100 (Good)
**Interpretation:** This is a solid mainstream credit card with fair terms typical of major banks. The no annual fee and 2% cash back make it competitive for everyday use, though the APR range means it's best for those who pay in full monthly.
terms_analysis.details:
**Details:**
- **Fees:** No annual fee, $40 late payment fee, 5% balance transfer fee, 5% cash advance fee
- **Interest rates:** 19.24-29.24% purchase APR, 29.99% cash advance APR (variable with Prime Rate)
- **Rewards:** 2% unlimited cash back on all purchases with no caps or categories
- **Payment terms:** 25+ day grace period to avoid interest, minimum payment is 1% of balance plus interest
- **Dispute resolution:** Mandatory binding arbitration required (cannot sue in court)

reddit_insights.positive:
• 2% cashback on all purchases with no annual fee
• $200 welcome bonus and cell phone insurance included
• Easy redemption and potential future travel point transfers
reddit_insights.negative:
• 3% foreign transaction fee limits international travel use
• Credit limit increases can be difficult to obtain
• Tied to Wells Fargo, which some users distrust
